notes.title: Logging Update
notes.content:
Hey all,

We've just pushed a small update that adds logging capabilities to arcade mode for bookkeeping purposes. You can access gameplay logs at "%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Subdream Studios\Mega Overload\Logs".

Thanks for playing Mega Overload!

notes.title: Version 1.08 - Easy Mode
notes.content:
Hey all,

We've just pushed Version 1.08 live, which includes a new easy mode with 10 brand new levels for those who would like a more chill Mega Overload experience.

Additionally, if you're running Mega Overload in an arcade setting, or want to give mixed reality recording a try, we've added the following keybinds to arcade mode:
[list]
 [*]1: Hides your player avatar
 [*]2: Hides your partner's player avatar
 [*]H: Toggle on-screen UI
 [*]Q: Presses 1st button on the left
 [*]W: Presses 2nd button from the left
 [*]E: Presses 3rd button from the left
 [*]R: Presses 4th button from the left
 [*]T: Presses 5th button from the left
[/list]

Stay tuned for further updates, and thanks for playing Mega Overload!

notes.title: Version 1.07
notes.content:
Hey all,

We've just pushed Version 1.07 live, which contains the following fixes and improvements:
[list]

[*]Added Oculus Touch controller support
[*]Minor balance change to Wave 2
[/list]
Stay tuned for further updates, and thanks for playing Mega Overload!

notes.title: Version 1.03
notes.content:
Hey all,

We've just pushed Version 1.03 live, which contains the following fixes and improvements:
[list]
[*]New Screenshot Features[list][*] Selfie Mode (Grip buttons)[*]First-Person Mode (Touchpad)[/list]
[*]Updated enemy projectile to improve visibility
[*]Updated bloom settings to improve visual clarity performance
[*]Updated particle systems to improve performance
[*]Added more on-screen HUD
[*]Fixed an issue with voice chat not disconnecting after a game
[*]Automatically lower volume during multiplayer to better hear the voice chat
[*]Minor balance change to Wave 4
[/list]
Stay tuned for further updates, and thanks for playing Mega Overload!
